items.summary: CFO recommendation: reject the proposed fleet admission-control-plane build this cycle. It duplicates existing control-plane work while capacity, measurement debt, failed repairs, and site overlap remain unresolved. Freeze new monetization claims, forecasts, and finance-impacting admissions. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; the $4.92 and 629 aggregate clicks are unattributed, so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift are unsupported. AI usage covers 2026-10-01: 85 calls, 11 instrumented sites, and $10.8396 cost, or about $0.1275 per call, but it is not comparable to the revenue window. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because no validated incremental outcome is linked to those calls. Infrastructure, hosting, registrar, labor, marketing, and other direct costs are absent; monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, revenue-target, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Retain only report-only reconciliation work for dated owner-provided cost exports and period alignment; do not move money, access banking, change billing, spend, forecast, or claim ROI.
